openaq_api_topup.note: API readings are used only for location-days the archive had not published; a later refresh replaces them with archive files.

default_analysis_rule: exclude hours flagged flat-line (>= 6 identical h) or isolated spike, EXCEPT supported spikes (verified Diwali night 18:00-06:00, or corroborated by another clean same-city station within +-1 h at >= 50% of the value and > 2x the city median); exclude station-days where matched-hour PM2.5 > PM10 + max(20% x PM10, 20 ug/m3) (impossible); peer-outlier station-days are flagged, not excluded
diwali_percent_note: Approved 2026-11-04: Diwali AQI percentages are never in the default answer (levels, categories and bulletin dates are the main result). Only when a user asks, diwali_aqi_percent gives baseline D-7..D-1 as a single figure if the D-14..D-8, D-7..D-1 and D-3..D-1 baselines agree within 25 points, otherwise a range. No single fixed baseline is approved, so the per-window percent_status in diwali_aqi_baselines stays pending_user_approval. Never a PM percentage.

attribution.opencity: CPCB data via OpenCity (data.opencity.in), public domain
attribution.bulletins: CPCB daily AQI bulletins, parsed by UrbanEmissions.info (GODL); dates after UrbanEmissions' last update read from CPCB's own bulletin PDFs (cpcb.gov.in)
